summary: Tallahatchie County, MS 100ft Aermotor LS-40 registered by NHLR in 2023 as US 1736; the register says the site appears privately owned, with no build date or public access described.

facts.status_note: Described as present in the July 2, 2023 register visit; no later report found
facts.agency: Mississippi Forestry Commission (cooperator); register lists administration as privately owned

corrections.why: The register lists Privately Owned as the administrator and the MFC only as a cooperator; private ownership is a status, not an agency.
The register description says the site appears to be privately owned now.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the NHLR entry, whose only visit is dated 7/2/23. Its description is garbled ('This form MFC site') and could mean a former or current MFC site. Searches and the Wikipedia article on Teasdale found no build date, builder, staffing, fire history or post-2023 report. Ownership is only described as appearing private; keep the record from implying public access. The NHLR photos are from the same 2023 visit.
